## Deck Goal
Teach frontend-oriented AEM developers how versioned frontend source becomes browser-delivered clientlibs, how categories, dependencies and embeds form runtime contracts, and how to debug the artifact the browser actually received.

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Class 12 of a seven-week AEM Sites course, delivered Tuesday, September 1, 2026. The audience understands AEM Resources, dialogs, persisted properties, HTL and browser evidence. This class connects the Week 3 Guide Card frontend source to the AEM clientlib build and delivery path.",
    "core_claim": "A frontend change is complete only when versioned source is compiled into the intended clientlib category, included once by the correct owner and verified in the browser-delivered artifact.",
    "canonical_facts": [
      "A client library is a cq:ClientLibraryFolder that organizes CSS, JavaScript and supporting resources.",
      "The categories property provides logical runtime names used by pages and other clientlibs.",
      "A clientlib below /apps uses allowProxy=true to be delivered through /etc.clientlibs.",
      "css.txt and js.txt define ordered clientlib source entries.",
      "WKND frontend source is edited below ui.frontend/src/main/webpack.",
      "Webpack produces optimized output below ui.frontend/dist.",
      "aem-clientlib-generator transforms distribution output into clientlibs below ui.apps.",
      "Maven orchestrates the frontend build and deployable AEM package.",
      "dependencies loads another category as a separate runtime contract.",
      "embed combines selected library content into the current clientlib output.",
      "The WKND archetype includes site and dependency categories through editable-template Page Policy.",
      "Shared site assets should load once while Guide Card CSS and optional JavaScript remain narrowly scoped.",
      "Browser debugging follows source import, build output, clientlib category, page inclusion, network response, cache and console evidence."
    ],
    "canonical_terms": [
      "cq:ClientLibraryFolder",
      "categories",
      "dependencies",
      "embed",
      "allowProxy",
      "css.txt",
      "js.txt",
      "ui.frontend/src/main/webpack",
      "ui.frontend/dist",
      "aem-clientlib-generator",
      "ui.apps",
      "/etc.clientlibs/",
      "Page Policy",
      "clientlib-site",
      "clientlib-dependencies"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "Use one CSS change to .cmp-guide-card. Build a six-rung evidence ladder: Git source, import/entry point, ui.frontend/dist, ui.apps clientlib/category, page source plus /etc.clientlibs request, response/cache/console result. Each rung must have one observable pass/fail artifact."
  }
}
